CreateNamespace.description_en: Creates a namespace in AI Registry and returns the corresponding namespace ID
CreateNamespace.description_zh: 创建 AI Registry 的命名空间，返回对应的命名空间 ID

CreatePrompt.description_en: Create a prompt and create the initial draft version content of that prompt
CreatePrompt.description_zh: 创建提示词，并创建该提示词的初始的草稿版本内容

CreatePromptVersion.description_en: Creates a new version of a prompt. The new version defaults to draft status. An error is returned if a draft version already exists
CreatePromptVersion.description_zh: 新建提示词的版本，新版本默认为草稿状态。如果草稿版本已经存在，则会报错

CreateSkillDraft.description_en: Creates a Skill draft and returns the Skill version
CreateSkillDraft.description_zh: 创建 Skill 草稿，返回 Skill 版本

DeleteNamespace.description_en: Deletes a specified namespace from the AI Governance Center. The system checks whether the namespace contains any resources in use (such as Skills or Prompts) before deletion. If such resources exist, the deletion fails
DeleteNamespace.description_zh: 删除 AI 治理中心的指定命名空间，删除时会检查命名空间下有无使用中的资源存在（Skill/Prompt 等），如果存在则删除失败

DownloadSkillVersionViaOss.description_en: Downloads a skill version through OSS and returns the OSS download URL
DownloadSkillVersionViaOss.description_zh: 通过 OSS 下载 Skill 版本 - 返回 OSS 下载 URL

GetNamespace.description_en: Queries the details of an AI Governance Center namespace
GetNamespace.description_zh: 查询 AI 治理中心命名空间详细信息

GetPrompt.description_en: Retrieves the details of a prompt
GetPrompt.description_zh: 获取 Prompt 详情信息

GetPromptVersion.description_en: Query the detailed information of a specified version of a prompt
GetPromptVersion.description_zh: 查询提示词指定版本的详细信息

GetSkillDetail.description_en: Retrieves the metadata and version information of a skill
GetSkillDetail.description_zh: 获取 Skill 的元数据和版本信息

GetSkillImportFileUrl.description_en: Retrieves a pre-signed URL for uploading a Skill to OSS. The client uses the returned URL to perform a PUT request to upload the Skill
GetSkillImportFileUrl.description_zh: 获取上传 Skill 到 OSS 的 URL，客户端使用返回的 URL 执行 PUT 上传 Skill

GetSkillVersionDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified version

ListNamespaces.description_en: Lists the namespaces in the AI Governance Center
ListNamespaces.description_zh: 列出 AI 治理中心的命名空间列表

ListPromptVersions.description_en: Lists the versions of a prompt

ListPrompts.description_en: Lists the prompts in a namespace
ListPrompts.description_zh: 列出命名空间下的提示词列表

OfflineSkill.description_en: Offlines a Skill or a specific version of a Skill
OfflineSkill.description_zh: 下线 Skill 或者 Skill 的某个版本

OnlineSkill.description_en: Publishes a skill or a specific version of a skill
OnlineSkill.description_zh: 上线 Skill 或者 Skill 的某个版本

PublishSkillVersion.description_en: Publishes a specific version of a Skill
PublishSkillVersion.description_zh: 发布 Skill 的某个版本

SubmitPromptVersion.description_en: Publishes a draft version of a prompt as an official version. The specified version must be a draft version
SubmitPromptVersion.description_zh: 将提示词的草稿版本提交发布为正式版本。要求指定的版本必须为草稿版本

SubmitSkillVersion.description_en: Submits a specific version of a skill for review
SubmitSkillVersion.description_zh: 将 Skill 的某个版本提交审核

UpdatePrompt.description_en: Modifies the metadata of a prompt, such as the description and business tags
UpdatePrompt.description_zh: 修改提示词的元数据，例如描述，业务标签等

UpdatePromptVersion.description_en: Updates the content of a prompt version. Only the draft version of a prompt can be modified
UpdatePromptVersion.description_zh: 更新提示词版本内容。只支持修改提示词的草稿版本

UpdateSkillBizTags.description_en: Updates business tags for a skill

UploadSkillViaOss.description_en: Uploads a skill (ZIP) from OSS by pulling the file content from OSS and uploading it to Nacos
UploadSkillViaOss.description_zh: 通过 OSS 上传 Skill (ZIP) - 从 OSS 拉取文件内容后上传到 Nacos
